layman_headline: Market fear lingers — holding current positions while waiting for a clearer setup.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is stuck in a fearful mood with Bitcoin hovering around $63K and most altcoins drifting lower. Our two current positions in Solana and Chainlink are both slightly underwater (about -1% each) but well within their stop-loss ranges. The swing trade candidates this cycle are either wildly overextended after 70-160% weekly runs or slowly bleeding without clear bottoms — neither is a safe entry.
layman_action: Hold your current SOL and LINK positions. No new buys right now. Wait for either a clearer pullback entry or a breakout confirmation before committing more capital.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates present unfavorable risk/reward profiles. AKE (+163% 7d), H (+89% 7d), and VELVET (+74% 7d) are massively extended parabolic moves with no RSI or MACD data to confirm any consolidation — chasing these historically leads to sharp drawdowns. FET and INJ are down 6-7% weekly but sit at -92% to -96% from ATH with no clear catalyst or volume surge suggesting a bottom. ETHFI gained 24% weekly but lacks technical confirmation. BTC dominance at 56.2% continues to suppress altcoin performance broadly. Fear & Greed at 34 is improving from 30.3 weekly average, but our signal credibility data shows Fear_Greed has only a 50% win rate — not actionable alone. The prudent move is to let existing positions play out toward their targets.
